coordination_holds_append: D-073 removes the nominal 0.37 m front-end gap from both technical benches. Each 9.00 m bench starts at X=0.18 m, the interior face of the front wall, and ends at X=9.18 m.

The corner-start geometry leaves a nominal 0.27 m plan separation between each 0.75 m-deep side-wall bench and its adjacent 4.80 m front industrial-door opening. Coordinate jambs, tracks, seals, guards, handles and maintenance access with the selected door system.
Provide a buildable corner/end condition with no inaccessible dirt trap, while retaining removable bench services, facade drainage and independent structural backing.
